name: ModelVariant831_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant831_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (sparks gather on a model part under a growing glow that flies to a second part, then burst out with beams, a fading core and halo and a white flash); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-848/945 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant848_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and the PAL height, at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
